items.title: John "Knocky" Parker Interview, 1963-08-28
items.q: I was surprised to visit Trevor Titchener in St. Louis

ctx.x: that I used to like mainly. What generally were the kind of roles that you had around the house?

Oh, we had old Hilo March and all those that were popular at the time. And, but I do remember that thing by Russell Robinson. And I was surprised to visit Trevor Titchener in St. Louis to see some, some beautiful Creole bells, a cakewalk. And that was one of the ones he put this on and I remembered that years ago this is an old tune that I had particularly liked and had played many, many times. We had old, all the old carry mills things and pieces like Snow Deer, Rufus on Parade, all the old cakewalks and early…
When was it then that you got the phonograph and started listening to the records?
